shellCommands.command: ls -la && cat AGENTS.md && cat package-lock.json | head -30 && ls -R .agents | head -50

cat package.json index.html tsconfig.json vite.config.ts .gitignore; ls -R src __agent_eval__; cat src/*; sed -n 1,70p .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs 2>&1 | head; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/package.json | grep '"version"'

grep -n -i -B2 -A25 "^## .*navigation" .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md | head -80; npm view @gravity-ui/navigation version peerDependencies 2>&1 | head -30; npm view @gravity-ui/icons version peerDependencies 2>&1 | head

npm install @gravity-ui/navigation@7.1.3 @gravity-ui/icons @bem-react/classname 2>&1 | tail -8; .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh navigation AsideHeader 2>&1 | head -40; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/ node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/docs 2>&1 | head -30
cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation && cat build/docs/INDEX.md | head -60; ls build/docs/components; grep -n -i -A12 "required setup\|styles" README.md | head -50

cd /home/sandbox/workspace && sed -n 1,140p node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/docs/components/AsideHeader.md; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/docs/components/AsideHeader; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/ | head; for i in House Gear Layers3Diagonal CircleInfo Moon Sun; do ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/${i}.js 2>&1 | tail -1; done

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build && grep -rn "renderFooter\|renderContent\|logo?\|menuItems\|onItemClick\|current?\|itemWrapper" docs/components/AsideHeader.md | head -30; find . -name "AsideHeader.d.ts" -o -name "FooterItem.d.ts" | head;

sed -n 355,376p docs/components/AsideHeader.md | cut -c1-260; grep -n "FooterItem" docs/components/Footer.md docs/components/AsideHeader.md | head -8; cat esm/components/AsideHeader/components/FooterItem/FooterItem.d.ts; grep -n "logo\|LogoProps" docs/components/AsideHeader.md | head -5; grep -n "^| \(text\|icon\|href\|onClick\|iconSize\|wrapper\)" docs/components/Logo.md | cut -c1-200; grep -n "ThemeProvider\|useThemeValue\|useTheme\b" ../../uikit/build/esm/components/theme/*.d.ts | head

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm && cat components/types.d.ts | sed -n 1,120p; grep -n "logo" components/AsideHeader/types.d.ts; cat components/Logo/Logo.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -30; grep -n "renderContent\|renderFooter" components/AsideHeader/types.d.ts

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components && cat Card/Card.d.ts | head -30; cat theme/types.d.ts | head -20; grep -n "content\|checked\|onUpdate" Switch/Switch.d.ts | head; grep -n "options\|value\|onUpdate" RadioButton/RadioButton.d.ts | head; grep -n "theme\|type" Label/Label.d.ts | head
